definitions.explanation: An urban area; a populated place.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{静|しず}かです。
{町|まち}で{買|か}い{物|もの}をしました。
{新|あたら}しい{町|まち}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しました。
examples.english: I moved to a new town.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{駅|えき}が{二|ふた}つあります。
examples.english: There are two stations in this town.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}が{生|う}まれた{町|まち}は{山|やま}の{近|ちか}くにあって、{空気|くうき}がとてもきれいでした。
examples.english: The town where I was born was near the mountains, and the air was very clean.

notes:
{町|まち} refers to a town or urban area, often used for smaller municipalities or neighborhoods.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {町|まち}: town, municipality (administrative unit)
- {街|まち}: city streets, downtown area (emphasis on the urban atmosphere)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {町|まち}に{出|で}る: to go into town
- {町|まち}で{買|か}い{物|もの}をする: to shop in town
- {町|まち}を{歩|ある}く: to walk around town
- {町|まち}{並|な}み: townscape, row of houses

RELATED WORDS:
- {村|むら}: village (smaller than {町|まち})
- {市|し}: city (larger than {町|まち})
- {都会|とかい}: urban area, city
